messages:
jess_support: FYI customer (acct: orbit-inc) says all per-model QPS lines in Console are showing 0 since ~16:30 UTC. Global QPS is normal. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood/internal/attachments/shot123.png
liam_runtime: looking
jess_support: Panel: 'Model throughput (per model)' dash id=8721 panel=4. They say it started after a config push at ~16:10.
nina_monitoring: I ran some queries: `sum(rate(redwood_model_qps[5m])) by (model_id)` => 0. `sum(rate(redwood_model_qps[5m])) by (model_name)` => normal numbers.
liam_runtime: that strongly suggests the metric label changed (templating uses model_id). Any recent exporter changes?
nina_monitoring: yes, PR #4321 standardized exporter labels. Excerpt: `- labels: {model_id: "..."}` -> `+ labels: {model_name: "..."}`. It was merged ~16:05.
sam_oncall: that would break dashboards that use `label_values(redwood_model_qps, model_id)` as a template var.
maria_sre: quick mitigation paths: 1) change dashboard var to `label_values(redwood_model_qps, model_name)` or 2) add a Prometheus recording rule that recreates model_id from model_name.
liam_runtime: rollback exporter is risky (affects other teams). Prefer dashboards + a compatibility recording rule.
nina_monitoring: drafted a recording rule using label_replace to synthesize model_id from model_name:
```
- record: redwood_model_qps_by_model_id
  expr: sum by (model_id) (label_replace(redwood_model_qps, "model_id", "$1", "model_name", "(.*)"))
```
That will let existing panels keep working until we migrate dashboards.
carlos_ds: this impacted Dedicated customer dashboards and alerted customers that their throughput was 0, so it's customer-visible.
liam_runtime: OK. I'll programmatically patch affected Grafana template vars and roll the recording rule. Assigning to eng-runtime + monitoring. ETA ~30m.
deploy-bot: started rollout: apply recording-rule redwood_model_qps_by_model_id -> monitoring-prod (canary region)
maria_sre: canary looks clean; metrics in that region's grafana now show values for the per-model panel.
liam_runtime: running dashboard update script: `./scripts/update-var.sh --dash 8721 --from model_id --to model_name` then patching other dashboards (8810, 9002).
deploy-bot: dashboard patch completed (patch-2026-03-17-01).
jess_support: told customer to check; they confirmed graphs are back for their org.
liam_runtime: root cause: exporter label rename without dashboard compatibility checks. Action items: add an integration test for label renames, add runbook for dashboard var migrations, and notify downstream teams before label changes. I'll open issues.
nina_monitoring: opened ISSUE-612: "Exporter label rename broke per-model QPS dashvars" -> assigned to eng-runtime + monitoring.
sam_oncall: recommend adding an alert that fires when `count(label_values(redwood_model_qps, model_name)) != count(label_values(redwood_model_qps, model_id))` or when template vars return empty, to catch label drift early.
liam_runtime: good call. I'll add the alert to the monitoring backlog and follow up with a short postmortem.
